shared_elements: schematic linear human figures with stick limbs
justification: Both depict schematic monochrome rock-art painted figures in the same linear stick-and-outline convention, and both include a boat with an upcurved prow crewed or accompanied by small stick-limbed human forms plus an animal-like creature in B and crew rows in A. However, A is dominated by two large multi-tiered ships with rows of identical crew strokes and no dominant single figure, whereas B centres on one large individual figure with outstretched arms above a small vessel and a separate small quadruped, so the composition and emphasis differ substantially.
